The Journey

FROM STUDENT
TO SYSTEMS
INTEGRATOR.

2020 — 2021 · Chapter 01
WHERE IT
STARTED.
Life Choices Coding Academy · Cape Town

Before AWS and production deployments, there was a classroom in Cape Town. Life Choices combined professional life coaching with hands-on software development — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, SQL. It wasn't just a bootcamp. It was a mindset shift.

The person in that classroom didn't know he'd be managing cloud infrastructure for global insurance platforms a few years later. He just knew he wasn't stopping.

HTML/CSSJavaScriptPythonSQLSDLCLife Choices
2021 · Chapter 02
FIRST JOB.
REAL STAKES.
LC Studio · QA Engineer Intern · Cape Town

The internship was the first time the work was real — real clients, real deadlines, real bugs that affected real users. I learned Selenium, JIRA, TestRail. But more than the tools, I learned what happens when you miss a defect.

This built the systematic thinking and attention to detail that I carry into every deployment today. That photo with a colleague at the desk — that energy of two people solving something together — never left me.

SeleniumJIRATestRailManual TestingAgile
// Debugging sessions · LC Studio, Cape Town · 2021
2022 — 2024 · Chapter 03
LEVELLING UP
AT EQUISOFT.
Equisoft · Software Developer

Joining Equisoft as a Developer was the pivot point. I went from testing software to building and configuring it — Oracle OIPA, JSreports, Freemarker, REST APIs on enterprise insurance platforms serving clients across Africa and North America.

Oracle OIPAJavaScriptFreemarkerREST API
2024 — Present · Chapter 04
OWNING THE
INFRASTRUCTURE.
Equisoft · Systems Integrator

Now I own end-to-end infrastructure operations on cloud-hosted, globally distributed insurance platforms. AWS, Ansible automation, NGINX/OpenResty WAF, Grafana monitoring, Azure DevOps CI/CD.

When the senior engineer was away, I covered everything — investigated a production MuleSoft gateway failure, deployed new services across all environments, kept it all running. That work was recognised by the director.

From a Cape Town classroom to enterprise cloud. That's the story.

AWSAnsibleNGINXLuaTerraformGrafanaDocker
Beyond the Terminal

THE PERSON
BEHIND THE
ENGINEER.

⚽
Football First

Football isn't just a sport — it's the language I grew up speaking. I'm passionate about the game, the tactics, the culture. And my club? FC Barcelona. Més que un club. The way Barça plays — possession, intelligence, creativity under pressure — is honestly how I try to approach engineering problems too.

Culé for Life
💻
Mr. Robot Changed Everything

If I had to point to one thing that made me want to work in tech, it's Mr. Robot. Elliot Alderson showed me that code isn't just syntax — it's power, it's storytelling, it's changing the world. That series will always inspire the work I do. It's why I care about security, about systems, about what's really happening underneath the surface.

fsociety
🤖
AI & What's Next

I'm genuinely excited about AI innovation — not just as a buzzword but as a tool that changes what's possible. I built FirstStep with Groq LLaMA and FareFlow with real payment infrastructure because I believe technology should solve real problems for real people. South Africa has too many problems that tech can fix. I want to be part of that.
